summary: Revision of the journal entry following a check against the session logs and the YS 1.1 research repository, parallel to the Russian revision: corrections on the origin of dictionary senses, the adhikṛta wording, the scale of editorial changes, the agents’ role, the English edition, sentence-level analysis and the sources of the Pāṇini check; additions on the gap in the analysis of nirodham abhimukhaṃ karoti and on the conditions of the comparison with YS 1.2. The Larson wording is unchanged: the author confirmed having searched for the full text without finding it in open access. No substantial issues: the version is ready for publication from the review perspective. Two minor points from the previous review were fixed by the author’s decision.

checks.explanation: New paragraphs match the surrounding text; no mixed scripts; the number of dashes is unchanged. Points from the previous review fixed; the remaining uses of “however” match the published text.
Sections and table kept; clarifications built into existing paragraphs.
The table in section 2, section 3 and section 6 now agree: only the Russian translation was fixed before Woods; the YS 1.1 work is described as not autonomous.
Checked against the same evidence as the Russian revision; statements are identical in substance. Links unchanged.
